claim: SANTE at 7-10 years: median seizure frequency reduction from baseline was 75% at 7 years; focal to bilateral tonic-clonic seizures reduced by 71%; definite+probable SUDEP rate 2.0/1000 person-years.

bibliographic_record.authors: Salanova V, Sperling MR, Gross RE, Irwin CP, Vollhaber JA, Giftakis JE, Fisher RS, SANTÉ Study Group.
bibliographic_record.title: The SANTÉ study at 10 years of follow-up: Effectiveness, safety, and sudden unexpected death in epilepsy.

supporting_passage: At 7 years, median seizure frequency percent reduction from baseline was 75% (p < .001), with no outcome differences related to prior vagus nerve stimulation or resective surgery. [...] The most severe seizure type, focal to bilateral tonic-clonic, was reduced by 71%. [...] Prior to study closure, 57 active subjects continued therapy at 14 study centers, with follow-up of at least 10 (maximum 14) years.
